entities.name: Leonardo da Vinci
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Italian polymath (1452–1519) who epitomized the Renaissance ideal. A painter, sculptor, architect, scientist, engineer, and inventor, his works include the Mona Lisa and The Last Supper. His notebooks reveal centuries-ahead insights into anatomy, flight, and engineering.
